### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

## MEHR-O-MAH TOURIST COMPLEX

Mehr-O-Mah Tourist Complex is 6 km away from Qom on the Qom-Tehran highway (one of the busiest major
roads in the country). The complex is situated on an area of approximately 40,000 sq.m (430,555
sq.ft) and has almost 9,000 sq.m (96,875 sq.ft) of internal floor space on two floors. Several
common, open and public spaces can be found in the complex. One of the most impressive components of
these public spaces is a kind of curved linear atrium that connects the two floors of the building
and spatially integrates the entire complex. This atrium continues in one-story layers and in
dividing spaces and restaurants.

][9]

## “GOD IS IN DETAILS“

[

## SAM COMMERCIAL CENTER

Iran’s Building of the Year 2018 | Special Acknowledgment Middle East Architect Award 2018 |
Finalist | Public Sector SAM Complex Design Competition 2013 | 1st Place | Commercial This 18-story
commercial building is situated in the remarkable Pasdaran Street in Tehran. The building is 50 m
(164 ft) high, and its usable areas comprise of 17,000 sq.m (183,000 sq.ft). The architect divided
the project into two parts by drawing an imaginary line and considered different actions against
the environment. The lower part of this imaginary line was for the local interaction and the upper
part generally displayed the project’s interaction with the city. Below the imaginary line, the
possibility of space creation was provided for the inactive presence of citizens by cutting the form
at the main entrance as well as giving its parts to the streets. Moreover, the moments of
pedestrians pause on the entrance steps became the street landscape. Cutting the form on the
southern side and forming the yard encourage the people to circulate around the building.

][10]

## “AN IDEA IS SALVATION BY IMAGINATION”

[

## SIVAN COMMERCIAL AND RESIDENTIAL TOWERS

Sivan project is a multipurpose tower that is situated in a land of 7,000 square meters in one of
the best zones of Mazandaran province, with both commercial and residential units. The first two
commercial floors are separated from the 10 residential floors by a hanging garden. The commercial
floors consist of three separate towers that have access to each other through the commercial
section. The façade of this project is architecturally designed in a way that well describes its
dual commercial and residential use. In this regard, the use of modern and luxury materials in the
façade, such as curtain wall, Aqua Panel cement board, metal punch and glass handrail, at first
glance, introduces a unique and modern building in the viewer's mind.

][11] [

## GOL GOHAR SIRJAN HEAD OFFICE

Having rich iron ore mines, Golgohar mineral area is one of the most known mineral-industrial hubs
in Middle East with a huge capacity for becoming a large and competitive area in Iran and even the
world. These mineral reserves are located in Kerman province. The new head office buildings were
located in Sirjan city included two cylindrical 6 story buildings that are linked to lower
rectangular cubes in the lower floors. The external wall of these buildings is covered with a Face
Cap system of Curtain Wall which the aluminum louver shell in 70 cm distance prevents the intense
sun arrival inside the building, and in order to service and maintain these two shells service
passages has been installed between these two. In non-transparent sections, the ceramic has been
installed with cladding invisible installation fittings system. Appropriate use of these materials
has gained a beautiful and modern effect of the buildings.

][12] [

## ATRIA OF CONCERT HALL

In the eastern zone of Iran Mall, the concert hall has two symmetrical glass cube atria on the north
and south sides, with a total plan area of about 1,700 sq.m (18,300 sq.ft). Each glass façade atria
have a height of about 17.5 m (57.4 ft), including five vertical modules and two reversed sloped
walls in the east zone. One important design aspect of this project is the wind loads expected
during the lifetime of the building. A wind tunnel study has been carried out by Wacker Ingenieure
(Wind Engineering Consultants) to determine the inputs for structural design, components and
cladding design.

][13]

## ‍**Stockist Distributor Pipa Fitting, Valve, Flange, Gasket dan Pipa Terbaik**

Pipa fitting adalah kebutuhan dasar dalam proses produksi pada berbagai industri seperti minyak dan
gas, petrokimia, kimia, pembangkit listrik, pertambangan, kelapa sawit, pulp & paper, karet, air
minum dalam kemasan, farmasi, kosmetik dan masih banyak lainnya. **Pipa fitting terdiri dari
berbagai komponen seperti gate valve atau katup gerbang, ball valve atau katup bola, globe valve,
butterfly valve atau katup kupu-kupu, buttweld fittings elbow las besi, tee las besi, reducer
concentric, reducer eccentric, tee, flange welding neck, flange socket weld, flange slip on, spiral
wound gasket dan pipa besi carbon steel dan stainless steel. Alvindo Catur Sentosa memiliki jenis
jenis valve, flange, buttweld fittings, forged fittings, gasket dan pipa dengan bahan material cast
iron, ductile iron, carbon steel dan stainless steel, tersedia juga valve dengan standard JIS, DIN,
ANSI / ASME. **

## **Beli Pipa Fitting Berkualitas dan Original di Alvindo Catur Sentosa**

Alvindo Catur Sentosa (ACS) merupakan stockist distributor pipa fitting dimana kamu dapat membeli
aneka kebutuhan valve, buttweld fittings, forged fittings, flange, spiral wound gasket dan pipa
dengan untuk kebutuhan pembangun pabrik baru, pengembangan proses produksi atau sekedar untuk
maintenance, repair dan operations (MRO). Proses pembelian dapat dilakukan dengan cara menghubungi
tim sales melalui fitur “Request for Quotation” pada website ini, live chat via Whatsapp atau
dilakukan secara online di Official Store Alvindo Catur Sentosa di Tokopedia dan berbagai
marketplace kesayangan Anda. Prosedur kerja yang baik dan tim yang berpengalaman akan membantu Anda
untuk menghemat waktu, tenaga dan pikiran dari proses penawaran harga hingga pesanan Anda tiba di
tempat Anda. Saat hendak membeli produk pipa fitting sangat diperlukan untuk memperhatikan rekam
jejak yang menjual karena produk pipa fitting sangat krusial untuk operasional perusahaan Anda
karena akan berdampak pada keamanan dan keselamatan kerja karyawan Anda. Karena iming-iming harga
yang murah, banyak orang yang sering terpengaruh sehingga akhirnya terbeli produk pipa fitting palsu
atau tidak sesuai spesifikasi. Anda tidak perlu takut saat membeli pipa fitting di Alvindo Catur
Sentosa, untuk menjaga kepercayaan Anda, Alvindo Catur Sentosa selalu menyediakan sertifikat produk
atau mill test certificate (MTC) asli yang diterbitkan oleh manufaktur produk yang kami jual,
Alvindo Catur Sentosa juga memiliki alat uji kebocoran hydrotest valve dan layanan uji material
seperti *positive material identification (PMI) test*.

## APPLIED PLASTICS CORPORATION IS AN INNOVATOR IN HIGH PERFORMANCE ANTI-STICK AND SAFE HANDLING
## PRODUCTS

Applied Plastics has made significant investments in proprietary fabric coating processes,
specialized equipment and technology to support the production of high-temperature fabrics, belting
and coatings.

### [APPLON™ BELTING ][10]

Our Applon™ fluoropolymer coated conveyor belting is known for its anti-stick properties and ability
to withstand continuous service temperatures of 500°F.

### [APPLON™ COATINGS][11]

Our Applon™ coating is a Fluoropolymer spray release agent valued for its anti-stick properties and
resistance to other substances that could interfere with the end product.

### [APPLON™ & SILICA RESIN TAPES, PADS & TUBING][12]

Our Applon™ fluoropolymer impregnated fabrics can be fused together and molded into tapes, pads and
tubing for use in high temperature manufacturing operations of fragile products sensitive to the use
of metal.

## Applon

### Products

**Applon fabrics** are representative of the products offered by Applied Plastics Corp. of
Tuscumbia, Alabama. The products are a combination of various fabrics combines with Fluropolymer.
**Applon F** is a combination of Kevlar, glass and Nomex fabrics impregnated with Fluropolymer and
sintered at a high temperature.
**Applon C** is a glass or Kevlar fabric impregnated with Fluropolymer and carbon fill.

[ About Applon ][9]

## APPLIED PLASTICS CORPORATION IS AN INNOVATOR IN HIGH PERFORMANCE ANTI-STICK AND SAFE HANDLING
## PRODUCTS

Applied Plastics has made significant investments in proprietary fabric coating processes,
specialized equipment and technology to support the production of high-temperature fabrics, belting
and coatings.

### [APPLON™ BELTING ][10]

Our Applon™ fluoropolymer coated conveyor belting is known for its anti-stick properties and ability
to withstand continuous service temperatures of 500°F.

### [APPLON™ COATINGS][11]

Our Applon™ coating is a Fluoropolymer spray release agent valued for its anti-stick properties and
resistance to other substances that could interfere with the end product.

### [APPLON™ & SILICA RESIN TAPES, PADS & TUBING][12]

Our Applon™ fluoropolymer impregnated fabrics can be fused together and molded into tapes, pads and
tubing for use in high temperature manufacturing operations of fragile products sensitive to the use
of metal.

## Applon

### Products

**Applon fabrics** are representative of the products offered by Applied Plastics Corp. of
Tuscumbia, Alabama. The products are a combination of various fabrics combines with Fluropolymer.
**Applon F** is a combination of Kevlar, glass and Nomex fabrics impregnated with Fluropolymer and
sintered at a high temperature.
**Applon C** is a glass or Kevlar fabric impregnated with Fluropolymer and carbon fill.

# SETTING THE GLOBAL STANDARD FOR TENSILE ARCHITECTURE

With 70 years of experience worldwide, Birdair has worked with owners, architects, engineers and
contractors to design and build custom tensile fabric structures used to create innovative roofing
systems, canopies and skylights. As a turn-key specialty contractor, Birdair provides
pre-construction assistance; including design assistance, budgeting, construction methodologies and
project schedule development. Our in-house capabilities consist of design, engineering, fabrication,
installation and maintenance of tensile structures.

[Birdair van]

## **Tailored Solar Solutions, Powered by Innovation******

At **Couleenergy**, we create **custom solar modules** that fit every project: from **flexible
modules** and **balcony energy systems** to **BIPV integration** and large-scale installations. As a
**100% employee-owned company**, every project reflects our passion, innovation, and responsibility.

### **Why Choose Couleenergy?**
* **Flexible Solar Modules** – lightweight, durable, and adaptable to curved or mobile surfaces
* **Balcony Energy Systems** – compact solutions for urban households and apartments
* **BIPV Integration** – solar panels designed to blend seamlessly into buildings
* **Latest Solar Technologies** – high-efficiency** HPBC, ABC, TOPCon, HJT**, etc.****
* **Certified Quality** – TÜV, CE, and other international certifications
* **Global Trust** – powering projects in **39+ countries worldwide******
* **Employee-Owned Dedication** – your solar success is our shared success

Whether you are a **distributor, installer, project developer, or end user**, our expert team
supports you at every stage: from selecting the right solar modules to system integration, project
execution, and long-term service.

With Couleenergy, you get more than solar modules. You gain a partner who delivers **customized,
future-ready solar solutions** that ensure long-term performance and reliability.

**The future is bright — let’s build it together.******

Rope access is a method of working at height using specialist climbing techniques and equipment.

Yes — all Duoline Access technicians are fully IRATA-certified and trained to the highest safety
standards.

##### What sectors do you serve?

We support a wide range of industries including construction, energy, renewables, and commercial

Rope access is one of the safest methods for high-level work when performed by certified

# Specialists in Fabrication

Fabric8 Membrane Services is a Philippines-based fabrication business with 40+ employees and
Australian ex-pat management. Fabric8 operates from a 4,500m² state-of-the-art facility located in
Subic Bay - a secure special free trade zone. Clients include award-winning tensile fabric
contractors and structure rental companies in the USA, Australia, Middle East and South-East Asia.
Fabric8 specializes in contract fabrication of textile materials used in major projects globally
[VIEW ALL PRODUCTS][35]

# Services & Equipment

Fabric8 offers a range of products and services available worldwide. We specialise in a variety of
materials including PTFE-coated fiberglass, ETFE, PVC-coated polyester, HDPE shade cloth, vinyl,
polyethelene and canvas. We have the highest caliber fabrication equipment available for
plotting/cutting and welding both PVC and PTFE fabrics.

[VIEW OUR SERVICES][36]

FPG Study: Fluoropolymers at their End-of-Life

New study, prepared by Ramboll and commissioned by FPG, examines waste routes through which
fluoropolymers move at end of life, evaluating how effectively current treatment systems handle

applications, from the aviation industry and electric vehicles to medical devices and energy
production.

[Find out more][66]

## **What sets fluoropolymers apart?**

Fluoropolymers are advanced materials that differ fundamentally from other PFAS. They are known for
their extreme durability, chemical inertness, and non-stick properties. Unlike other polymers,
fluoropolymers remain stable under high temperatures and extreme environmental conditions making
them critical for a variety of interconnected sectors and high-tech industries. More importantly,
they cannot be substituted without compromising safety and performance.

# [AI-monitoring of bee hive activity could aid beekeepers][7]

[Leave a reply][8]
Caption: Researchers working on the case study. Credit: University of Cordoba

A [December 2, 2025 University of Córdoba press release on EurekAlert][9] announces research into
the use of AI in beekeeping practices,

> A monitoring system devised by the University of Cordoba ascertains the flowering stages of each
> hive, with high precision, exploiting data on bees’ behavior
> 
> Beekeeping has existed for millennia, as evidenced by a painting in the Cueva de la Araña
> (Valencia), more than 8,000 years old, depicting a human figure collecting honey from a hole in a
> rock, with bees hovering around. This relationship between humans and bees is essential not only
> to obtain honey, pollen and wax, but also to conserve the honeybee (*Apis mellifera L.),
> *responsible for the pollination of thousands of crops.
> 
> The success of hives and beekeeping depends on flowering periods, which are irregular because they
> depend greatly on the season, rainfall, and temperatures. Reducing uncertainty and knowing the
> precise duration of flowering periods was the goal of a team from the Department of Electronics
> and Computer Engineering and the Department of Zoology at the University of Cordoba, which has
> been working for years on hive monitoring systems providing beekeepers with accurate data in real
> time.
> 
> The system designed allows them to ascertain the exact flowering time for each hive, from the
> beginning of the day until it ends, thanks to a weight sensor. “By observing how the weight of the
> hive varies throughout the day, and analyzing the curve that results from the weight measurements
> every 5 minutes, we obtain information about the current flowering stage,” explained
> Andrés Gersnoviez, lead author of the work.
> 
> Contrary to what one might think, it is not only the weight gain of the bees, loaded with nectar,
> that reveals the moment of flowering, but also when the bees begin to leave to forage (collect),
> the number of bees that leave and enter the hives, and how much time they spend outside them,
> among other things. “If you know when the hive’s minimum weight occurs, which is when they go out
> to look for food, and when the maximum occurs, you know that they have already returned. In
> addition to this, knowing if that minimum and/or maximum have a peak or valley shape, as well as
> the difference in weight from the beginning of the day until it ends, all together tells us how
> long it has taken them to return, and the success they have had in their searches, which allows us
> to pinpoint the flowering phase,” the researcher explained.
> 
> With the data obtained from the hive sensors, the team designed a classifier using Artificial
> Intelligence algorithms with factors that describe the weight curve and relate that data to
> flowering. Once they had met their objective, they went further. “We saw that, within the
> flowering period, we could distinguish between an earlier stage and an end one,” Gersnoviez said.
> In this way, a system is obtained that is capable not only of determining whether flowering is
> impending, occurring, or finished, but also of distinguishing between an initial and a final
> flowering stage.
> 
> **Technology to facilitate beekeeping**
> 
> Beekeepers usually work with several apiaries featuring 40 or 50 hives. These apiaries are miles
> apart, sometimes hundreds, so knowing exact flowering times without having to visit them saves
> beekeepers time and allows them to carry out this age-old activity more efficiently. According to
> José Manuel Flores, a researcher who has participated in the work on the Zoology side, this helps
> to enhance harvests. “The system tells you that the flowering will end in a few days. This allows
> beekeepers to plan where to go to in order to collect the honey. If you arrive too early and the
> flowering hasn’t finished, you’re losing the part of the harvest that the hive can still generate.
> Conversely, if you arrive late and the flowering finished days before, the bees are already
> feeding on that honey, and part of the harvest is also lost.” It is especially useful for those
> who produce monofloral honey (of a single variety, such as orange blossom, chestnut, eucalyptus,
> or avocado, among many others), since, if it is not collected once the flowering is finished, the
> bees can take nectar from other flowerings of more distant crops, in which case the honey is no
> longer monofloral, and loses added value.
> 
> The monitoring system created through these teams’ collaboration provides much more information.

Мы располагаем современным оборудованием для работы с любыми типами материалов.

ЭТФЭ (ETFE)
Станок для сварки пленки ЭТФЭ (ETFE)

**Единственный в России и странах СНГ** выполненный по специальному заказу станок для сварки ЭТФЭ
(ETFE) даёт нам уникальную возможность реализовывать необычные и интересные проекты, о которых
раньше можно было только мечтать.

Станок управляется ЧПУ, что гарантирует постоянство качества результата.

силикон
Станок для сварки силикона

Уникальный станок позволяет вулканизировать силиконовые мембраны. Процессы происходят при очень
высокой температуре (более 400 градусов Цельсия), обеспечивая
**сварной шов прочностью выше, чем основной материал.**

ПВХ (PVC)
Плоттер для резки

Резальная машина конвейерного типа (плоттер) с системой вакуумной поддержки посредством ЧПУ легко и
эффективно управляет размещением шаблонов, минимизируя тем самым количество отходов.

Стол для раскроя размером 2600х3000 мм и разнообразные режущие лезвия позволяют выполнить самые
сложные и даже радиусные выкройки.

ПВХ (PVC)
Станок для ТВЧ сварки ПВХ (PVC)

Высокотехнологичный станок для сварки всех типов ПВХ (PVC)-сеток и мембран позволяет выполнить швы
различной сложной конфигурации шириной от 20 до 50 мм. Наличие ЧПУ автоматизирует процесс и
минимизирует количество ошибок и неточностей.

Наличие 16-метрового сварочного стола значительно увеличивает производительность линии за счет
сокращения количества перемещений материала.

ПТФЭ (PTFE)
Станок для сварки ПТФЭ (PTFE)

Изготовленный по нашему специальному заказу немецкой компанией MEDAG GmbH станок SWP 1200 служит для
сварки технических тканей, в том числе ПТФЕ (PTFE), при рабочей температуре 200°С - 400°С в
соответствии со свойствами материалов.

Стальные профили
Гибочный станок

Комплект гибочных станков позволяет изготавливать криволинейные формы из стальных профилей любого
сечения диаметром **до 325 мм!**

Металлоконструкции
Промышленный робот для 3D плазменной резки металлоконструкций

**Fanuc Arc Mate 100iC**
Роботизированный комплекс выполняет широкий спектр разнообразных операций по высокоскоростной сварке
и резке. В первую очередь, он предназначен для выполнения 3D-резки труб круглого сечения диаметром
от 50 до 114 мм. Применяемый плазменный источник обладает пробивной способностью, обеспечивающей
прожиг металла толщиной до 19 мм и рез металла толщиной до 25 мм.

ПВХ (PVC)
Станок для сварки ПВХ-мембран

**FIAB HPS Q-drive**
Приобретением новейшего станка для сварки ПВХ-мембран мы завершили формирование технологической
линии европейского уровня по производству каркасно-мембранных конструкций большого размера. Теперь в
одном производственном пространстве представлена вся технологическая линейка для компьютерного

Produzione di tutti i tipi di prodotti in PTFE vergine **dal 1998**. Precisione e tecnologia

aziende al mondo. Dopo approfonditi studi e formazione negli Stati Uniti e in Russia, FELIS SRL ha

di PTFE. Sfruttando questa tecnologia ed esperienza, l’azienda ha iniziato a produrre PTFE sia sotto
forma di semilavorati che di prodotti finiti.

di prodotti di alta qualità, ai prezzi competitivi, alla disponibilità immediata a magazzino e a una
rete logistica efficiente. Il continuo progresso tecnologico e le partnership strategiche di
know-how hanno posizionato FELIS SRL tra le poche aziende in Europa in grado di gestire l’intera
filiera produttiva del PTFE, offrendo un portafoglio di prodotti tra i più competitivi nel mercato
globale.

## TCI is proud to be the only supplier to offer PFA, FEP, ETFE, PVDF, ECTFE, cast PTFE films, and
## 100% PTFE CrossFilm™

Textiles Coated International (TCI) has proven itself to be first in fluoropolymer capabilities
after 30 plus years of manufacturing high-performance fluoropolymer films, laminates, and
composites. Our high-quality fluoropolymer materials continuously perform in the most challenging
thermal and chemical environments worldwide.

TCI produces fabrics for a variety of industries including architectural/greenhouse films, composite
process materials, removable insulation jacket materials, tank liners, secondary containment, radome
covers, floating roof seal materials, PTFE flexible ducting, and PTFE food belting. TCI is the
world’s leading manufacturer of high-performance PTFE materials for non-metallic expansion joint
manufacturers. Our superior material quality allows manufacturers to engineer successful long-term
solutions for fabric expansion joints, while TCI helps our customers to remain on the forefront of
new technologies for non-metallic expansion joints.

As the PTFE experts, TCI has decades of experience helping customers understand the effectiveness of
PTFE barrier materials. TCI produces a range of specialty textiles such as our 100% PTFE CrossFilm™,
a variety of PTFE-coated fiberglass fabrics, and other materials designed for optimal performance in
challenging applications.

# From seed plantingto the final
# delivery of goods

Zenith Eclipse plays a pivotal role in the agricultural and energy sectors. With a strong presence
in over 40 countries, we manage the entire value chain from cultivation and production to global
distribution, international trade, and logistics. Our commitment to excellence ensures seamless
operations, connecting high-quality products with markets worldwide.

Key Operations
Zenith Eclipse specializes in cultivating, processing, and distributing high-quality grains,
lentils, and seeds—including sunflower seeds, flaxseeds, and rapeseeds. With modern facilities, we
produce wheat flour and related wheat products to meet market needs.
[icon]
Expansion into Petrochemicals
We’ve also expanded into petrochemicals—including ethylene, propylene, and polyethylene—supporting
wider industrial demand and strengthening our reach across multiple sectors.

### Commitment and Responsibility

We’re committed to providing seeds you can count on—quality, reliable supply, and a responsible
approach from sourcing to delivery. We work to meet your needs and expectations while supporting
long-term, sustainable growth across the agricultural sector.

### Quality You Can Trust

From selection to final shipment, we keep a close eye on quality standards at every step. This focus
helps ensure consistent performance, customer satisfaction, and products that support strong results
season after season.

### Strong Distribution and On-Time Delivery

Our distribution network for grains and seeds is built to keep premium products accessible across a
wide range of agricultural markets. With efficient supply chain management, we make sure deliveries
arrive on time while maintaining the same high standards every time.

### Sustainable Agriculture

Sustainability is central to how we work. We support farming practices that strengthen integrity,
improve resource efficiency, and help farmers remain profitable—while also protecting soil health
and biodiversity for the future.

### Seed Processing with Purpose

After oil extraction, we turn the remaining seed meal into a valuable, nutrient-rich resource for
both livestock and plants. This approach supports healthier animal feed and helps ensure nothing
goes to waste—using the same strict quality standards applied to our seeds.

### Harvest Season and Global Reach

Harvest season is where a full year of work comes together. Our team carefully harvests, processes,
and stores seeds to protect quality, viability, and consistency. Backed by a global supply network,
we source from multiple regions and manage shipping efficiently so customers receive high-quality
products wherever they are.

## Innovation in Action

We champion a culture of innovation across our agriculture, energy, petrochemicals, and logistics
divisions. From precision farming and clean energy solutions to advanced petrochemical processes and
driven logistics, our teams constantly explore new ideas to drive efficiency and sustainability in
every sector. By turning fresh ideas into real‑world applications, we stay ahead of industry
challenges and deliver greater value to our customers and partners.

## Global Reach, Local Impact

Operating in over many countries, our influence is truly global—we help feed populations and fuel
industries by delivering essential commodities where they’re needed most. At the same time, we
believe in giving back: we work hand‑in‑hand with farming communities, support education and
environmental initiatives, and invest in the well‑being of the regions we call home. By balancing
worldwide impact with local commitment, Zenith Eclipse Co turns global success into shared
prosperity for communities and customers alike.
